过.zh: 这是我见过最美的景色了。
过.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ jiàn guo zuì měi dí jǐng sè le
过.en: This is the most beautiful sight that I have ever seen.
过.es: Este es el paisaje más bonito que he visto hasta ahora.

过.zh: 我没见过也没听过这样的事。
过.pinyin: Wǒ méi jiàn guo yě méi tīng guo zhè yàng de shì
过.en: I have neither seen nor heard of such a thing.
过.es: Nunca he visto o escuchado algo así.

过.zh: 我已经看过这部电影了。
过.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ jīng kàn guo zhè bù diàn yǐng le
过.en: I have seen the film before.

过.pinyin: Tā men guo zhe hé píng de shēng huó

牛奶.zh: 我买了几个鸡蛋和一点牛奶。
牛奶.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le jǐ ge jī dàn hé yī diǎn niú nǎi
牛奶.en: I bought a few eggs and a little milk.
牛奶.es: Compré algunos huevos y un poco de leche.

牛奶.pinyin: Niú yóu shì yòng niú nǎi zào de
牛奶.es: La mantequilla se hace de leche.

牛奶.pinyin: Zhè niú nǎi yǒu tè shū de qì wèi
牛奶.en: This milk has a peculiar smell.
牛奶.es: Esta leche tiene un olor extraño.

结婚.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng hé wǒ jié hūn ma

结婚.zh: 我不知道她是什么时候结婚的。
结婚.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhī dào tā shì shén me shí hou jié hūn de
结婚.en: I don't know when she got married.

结婚.zh: 我想和一个像她那样的女孩结婚。
结婚.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng hé yī ge xiàng tā nà yàng de nǚ hái jié hūn
结婚.en: I want to marry a girl like her.
结婚.es: Me quiero casar con una hija como ella.

结婚.zh: 我结婚了，而且有两个孩子。
结婚.pinyin: Wǒ jié hūn le ér qiě yǒu liǎng gè hái zi
结婚.en: I am married and have two children.
结婚.es: Estoy casada y tengo dos niños.

生气.pinyin: Tā gēn wǒ shēng qì le
Tā kāi shǐ shēng qì le

生气.zh: 生气是一种疯狂的形态。
生气.pinyin: Shēng qì shì yī zhǒng fēng kuáng de xíng tài
生气.en: Anger is a form of madness.
生气.es: El enojo es una forma de locura.

万.zh: 我用二万五千円买了这台相机。
万.pinyin: Wǒ yòng èr wàn wǔ qiān yuán mǎi le zhè tái xiàng jī
万.en: I bought this camera for 25,000 yen.

万.zh: 我卖了房子和家具，连同我的手饰一起才凑了五十万。
万.pinyin: Wǒ mài le fáng zi hé jiā jù lián tóng wǒ de shǒu shì yī qǐ cái còu le wǔ shí wàn
万.en: I sold my house and furniture, together with my jewelry, in order to scrape together a half a million.

万.zh: 我们花一万二千元买了这辆车。
万.pinyin: Wǒ men huā yī wàn èr qiān yuán mǎi le zhè liàng chē

万.zh: 我们还得付多一万日元。
万.pinyin: Wǒ men hái de fù duō yī wàn rì yuán
万.en: We had to pay ten thousand yen in addition.

麻烦.zh: 我很抱歉给你惹来所有的这些麻烦。
麻烦.pinyin: Wǒ hěn bào qiàn gěi nǐ rě lái suǒ yǒu de zhè xiē má fan
麻烦.en: I'm sorry to cause you all this trouble.

麻烦.zh: 麻烦你在四时叫我起床。我一定要乘到头班火车。
麻烦.pinyin: Má fan nǐ zài sì shí jiào wǒ qǐ chuáng wǒ yī dìng yào chéng dào tóu bān huǒ chē
麻烦.en: Call me at four; I must take the first train.
麻烦.es: Llámame a las cuatro; debo tomar el primer tren.

麻烦.zh: 能不能麻烦你告诉我去邻村怎么走？
麻烦.pinyin: Néng bù néng má fan nǐ gào su wǒ qù lín cūn zěn me zǒu
麻烦.en: Sorry, but can you show me the way to the next village?
麻烦.es: Disculpe, pero ¿puede mostrarme cómo llegar a la siguiente aldea?

麻烦.zh: 小心点驾驶，不然你就麻烦了。
麻烦.pinyin: Xiǎo xīn diǎn jià shǐ bù rán nǐ jiù má fan le
麻烦.en: Be careful driving or you'll have problems.
麻烦.es: Ten cuidado conduciendo o tendrás problemas.

文章.zh: 他刚发表一系列有趣的文章。
文章.pinyin: Tā gāng fā biǎo yī xì liè yǒu qù de wén zhāng
文章.en: He has just published an interesting series of articles.
文章.es: Él acaba de publicar una interesante serie de artículos.

文章.zh: 那就是那台他用来写文章的电脑。
文章.pinyin: Nà jiù shì nà tái tā yòng lái xiě wén zhāng de diàn nǎo
文章.en: That's the computer he used to write the article.
文章.es: Ésa es la computadora que usó para escribir el artículo.

文章.zh: 你有没有看过这篇文章？
文章.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu méi yǒu kàn guo zhè piān wén zhāng

文章.zh: 他的文章写得完美无瑕。
文章.pinyin: Tā de wén zhāng xiě de wán měi wú xiá
文章.en: His composition leaves nothing to be desired.
文章.es: Su composición no deja nada que desear.

假.pinyin: Tā de gù shi bù huì shì jiǎ de
假.es: Su historia no puede ser falsa.

假.pinyin: Wǒ nìng yuàn nín xiū yī tiān jiǎ
假.en: I would rather you had a day off.
假.es: Preferiría que tuvieras un día de descanso.

假.zh: 假的钻石和真的钻石有甚么分别？
假.pinyin: Jiǎ de zuàn shí hé zhēn de zuàn shí yǒu shèn má fēn bié
假.en: What is the difference between imitation and real diamonds?
假.es: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre los diamantes de imitación y los reales?

假.zh: 谣言最后被证明是假的。
假.pinyin: Yáo yán zuì hòu bèi zhèng míng shì jiǎ de
假.en: The rumor turned out to be false.

篇.zh: 这篇作文花了我两个小时来完成。
篇.pinyin: Zhè piān zuò wén huā le wǒ liǎng gè xiǎo shí lái wán chéng
篇.en: It took me 2 hours to finish the essay.
篇.es: Tardé dos horas en terminar la redacción.

篇.zh: 你有没有看过这篇文章？
篇.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu méi yǒu kàn guo zhè piān wén zhāng

篇.zh: 你只要读读这篇文章，就能知道那意外有多严重。
篇.pinyin: Nǐ zhǐ yào dú dú zhè piān wén zhāng jiù néng zhī dào nà yì wài yǒu duō yán zhòng
篇.en: You have only to read this article to see how serious the accident was.
篇.es: Sólo tienes que leer este artículo para ver qué tan grave fue el accidente.

篇.zh: 我们已经有那篇课文了吗？
篇.pinyin: Wǒ men yǐ jīng yǒu nà piān kè wén le ma
篇.en: Do we already have that text?

指.zh: 她把她的房间指给我看了。
指.pinyin: Tā bǎ tā de fáng jiān zhǐ gěi wǒ kàn le
Zhǐ zhe bié ren shì bù lǐ mào de
指.en: It is rude to point at others.
指.es: Es de mala educación señalar a los demás.

指.zh: 你能把最近的公车站指给我看吗?
指.pinyin: Nǐ néng bǎ zuì jìn de gōng chē zhàn zhǐ gěi wǒ kàn ma
指.en: Can you tell me where the nearest bus stop is?
指.es: ¿Puedes decirme dónde está la parada de autobús más cercana?

专业.pinyin: Wǒ shì zhuān yè shè yǐng shī

专业.zh: 我的儿子想成为一个专业高尔夫球手。
专业.pinyin: Wǒ de ér zi xiǎng chéng wéi yī ge zhuān yè gāo ěr fū qiú shǒu
专业.en: My son wants to become a professional golf player.
专业.es: Mi hijo quiere convertirse en un golfista profesional.

专业.zh: 书桌上一叠专业书里有几本卡通书混在里面。
专业.pinyin: Shū zhuō shàng yī dié zhuān yè shū lǐ yǒu jǐ běn kǎ tōng shū hún zài lǐ miàn
专业.en: There were some graphic novels mixed into the pile of specialty books on the desk.
专业.es: Había algunos libros de historietas mezclados con la pila de libros especializados del escritorio.

专业.pinyin: Wǒ de zhuān yè shì zōng jiào xué

国际.zh: 国际间的纷争一定要用和平的方法来解决。
国际.pinyin: Guó jì jiān de fēn zhēng yī dìng yào yòng hé píng de fāng fǎ lái jiě jué
国际.en: International disputes must be settled peacefully.
国际.es: Las disputas internacionales deben resolverse de forma pacífica.

国际.zh: 英语成为了一门国际语言。
国际.pinyin: Yīng yǔ chéng wéi le yī mén guó jì yǔ yán
国际.en: English has become an international language.
国际.es: El inglés se ha convertido en un idioma internacional.

国际.pinyin: Yīng yǔ shì guó jì yǔ yán
国际.es: El inglés es una lengua internacional.

国际.zh: 他是个国际银行的翻译。
国际.pinyin: Tā shì gè guó jì yín háng de fān yì
国际.en: He's an interpreter in an international bank.

污染.zh: 我们应该尽力不要污染环境。
污染.pinyin: Wǒ men yīng gāi jìn lì bù yào wū rǎn huán jìng
污染.en: We ought to do our best not to pollute our environment.
污染.es: Deberíamos esforzarnos al máximo para no ensuciar el medioambiente.

污染.pinyin: Fèi shuǐ jīng cháng wū rǎn hǎi yáng
污染.es: Las aguas residuales contaminan el mar a menudo.

污染.zh: 如果大家都懂得关心环境的话，就不会有噪音污染了。
污染.pinyin: Rú guǒ dà jiā dōu dǒng de guān xīn huán jìng de huà jiù bù huì yǒu zào yīn wū rǎn le
污染.en: Noise pollution could be avoided if only people were more sensitive to the environment.

污染.zh: 汽车尾气在城镇里造成了严重的污染。
污染.pinyin: Qì chē wěi qì zài chéng zhèn lǐ zào chéng le yán zhòng de wū rǎn
污染.en: Car exhaust causes serious pollution in towns.

胳膊.pinyin: Tā zhuā zhù le tā de gē bo
胳膊.en: He caught her by the arm.

胳膊.pinyin: Lìng yī gè zhuā zhù tā de gē bo
Tā bǎ shēn zi kào zài gē bo shàng
胳膊.es: Él se apoyó sobre sus codos.

胳膊.pinyin: Jǐng chá zhuā zhe xiǎo tōu de gē bo
胳膊.en: The policeman took the thief by the arm.
胳膊.es: El policía cogió al ladrón del brazo.

降落.pinyin: Míng tiān tā huì zài yuè qiú jiàng luò
降落.en: Tomorrow, he will land on the moon.

降落.zh: 这架客机降落在东京了。
降落.pinyin: Zhè jià kè jī jiàng luò zài dōng jīng le
降落.es: El avión a reacción aterrizó en Tokio.

降落.pinyin: Qǐ fēi bǐ jiàng luò róng yì
降落.en: Taking off is easier than landing.
降落.es: Despegar es más fácil que aterrizar.

降落.pinyin: Fēi jī jiù yào jiàng luò le
降落.en: The plane is about to land.

片.pinyin: Tā de fáng jiān yī piān láng jí
Zhè piān hú shì rì běn zuì shēn de
片.en: This lake is the deepest in Japan.
片.es: Este es el lago más profundo en Japón.

片.zh: 乔治给我寄了一张生日卡片。
片.pinyin: Qiáo zhì gěi wǒ jì le yī zhāng shēng rì kǎ piān
片.en: George sent me a birthday card.
片.es: George me envió una tarjeta de cumpleaños.

片.zh: 我见到一片白云在空中飘过。
片.pinyin: Wǒ jiàn dào yī piān bái yún zài kōng zhōng piāo guo
片.en: I saw a white cloud sailing across the sky.
片.es: Vi una nube blanca flotar a través del cielo.

必要.pinyin: Wǒ men méi bì yào jí
Nǐ méi bì yào nà me zhèng shì
必要.en: You don't have to be so formal.
必要.es: No tienes que ser tan formal.

必要.pinyin: Nǐ qí shí méi bì yào dài sǎn
必要.en: You needn't have taken an umbrella with you.
必要.es: No necesitabas llevar un paraguas contigo.

必要.zh: 我认为没有必要游说他。
必要.pinyin: Wǒ rèn wéi méi yǒu bì yào yóu shuō tā
必要.en: I don't see any point in persuading him.

承认.pinyin: Wǒ chéng rèn le wǒ de cuò wù
Wǒ chéng rèn tā shì duì de
承认.en: I admit that he is right.

承认.pinyin: Wǒ bì xū chéng rèn wǒ dǎ hū
承认.en: I must admit that I snore.

承认.zh: 我承认这可能不是最好的方法。
承认.pinyin: Wǒ chéng rèn zhè kě néng bù shì zuì hǎo de fāng fǎ
承认.en: I admit this may not be the best way of doing it.
承认.es: Admito que esta probablemente no es la mejor forma de hacerlo.

充满.zh: 你的脑袋充满了新点子。
充满.pinyin: Nǐ de nǎo dai chōng mǎn le xīn diǎn zi
充满.en: Your head was bursting with new ideas.
充满.es: Su cabeza rebosaba con nuevas ideas.

充满.pinyin: Wǒ xīn li chōng mǎn zhe kuài lè
充满.en: My heart was filled with happiness.

充满.zh: 女孩的眼睛充满了泪水。
充满.pinyin: Nǚ hái de yǎn jing chōng mǎn le lèi shuǐ
充满.en: The girl's eyes were filled with tears.
充满.es: Los ojos de la chica estaban llenos de lágrimas.

充满.zh: 百合的香气充满了整个房间。
充满.pinyin: Bǎi hé de xiāng qì chōng mǎn le zhěng gè fáng jiān
充满.en: A smell of lilies filled the room.
充满.es: Una fragancia a lirios colmaba la habitación.

切.pinyin: Tā yòng dāo qiē le ròu
切.en: He cut the meat with a knife.
切.es: Él cortó la carne con un cuchillo.

切.pinyin: Hú luó bo wǒ lái qiē ba
Bǎ tǔ dòu qiē yī xià

事实.zh: 不是因为某人不理事实它们就会不复存在了。
事实.pinyin: Bù shì yīn wèi mǒu rén bù lǐ shì shí tā men jiù huì bù fù cún zài le
事实.en: Facts do not cease to exist because they are ignored.
事实.es: Los hechos no dejan de existir por ser ignorados.

事实.zh: 我不敢探查得太深, 以免发现可怕的事实。
事实.pinyin: Wǒ bù gǎn tàn chá de tài shēn yǐ miǎn fā xiàn kě pà de shì shí
事实.en: I dare not probe too deeply, lest I uncover the awful truth!
事实.es: ¡No me atrevo a investigar demasiado profundamente, para no descubrir la horrorosa verdad!

事实.zh: 任何意见都是事实与谬误的混合体。
事实.pinyin: Rèn hé yì jiàn dōu shì shì shí yǔ miù wù de hùn hé tǐ
事实.en: Every opinion is a mixture of truth and mistakes.
事实.es: Toda opinión es una mezcla de la verdad y de errores.

事实.pinyin: Bào gào hé shì shí bù xiāng fú
事实.en: This account does not agree with the facts.
事实.es: Esta versión no concuerda con los hechos.

蛇.zh: 这条蛇是活的还是死的？
蛇.pinyin: Zhè tiáo shé shì huó de hái shi sǐ de
蛇.en: Is the snake alive or dead?

蛇.zh: 我们猜这是一种被蛇咬伤的毒。
蛇.pinyin: Wǒ men cāi zhè shì yī zhǒng bèi shé yǎo shāng de dú
蛇.en: We suspect it's about a poisoning by snake bite.
蛇.es: Suponemos que se trata de una intoxicación por mordedura de serpiente.

蛇.pinyin: Nǐ xǐ huan shé ma dāng rán bù xǐ huan

蛇.zh: 它长着女人的头、狮子的身体、一双羽翅以及蛇尾巴。
蛇.pinyin: Tā cháng zhe nǚ rén de tou shī zǐ de shēn tǐ yī shuāng yǔ chì yǐ jí shé wěi ba
蛇.en: It had the head of a woman, the body of a lion, the wings of a bird, and the tail of a serpent.
蛇.es: Tenía la cabeza de una mujer, el cuerpo de un león, las alas de una ave, y la cola de una serpiente.

期间.zh: 现在是看樱桃树的期间。
期间.pinyin: Xiàn zài shì kàn yīng táo shù de qī jiān
期间.en: Right now is the time of year to see the cherry blossoms.
期间.es: Es la época de ver los cerezos.

期间.zh: 暑假期间，我在邮局工作。
期间.pinyin: Shǔ jià qī jiān wǒ zài yóu jú gōng zuò
期间.en: I worked in a post office during the summer vacation.
期间.es: Trabajé en una oficina de correo durante las vacaciones de verano.

期间.zh: 他在那个事件期间支持我们。
期间.pinyin: Tā zài nà ge shì jiàn qī jiān zhī chí wǒ men
期间.en: He backed us up during that incident.

期间.zh: 我想在休假期间去法国。
期间.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zài xiū jià qī jiān qù fǎ guó
期间.en: I want to go to France for my vacation.

窗帘.pinyin: Wǒ men duǒ zài chuāng lián hòu mian ba

窗帘.zh: 当我拉开了窗帘时，在下雪呢。
窗帘.pinyin: Dāng wǒ lā kāi le chuāng lián shí zài xià xuě ne
窗帘.en: When I opened the curtains, it was snowing.
窗帘.es: Cuando abrí las cortinas, estaba nevando.

窗帘.pinyin: Tā cóng chuāng lián hòu chū lái le
窗帘.en: He came out from behind the curtain.
窗帘.es: Él salió de detrás de la cortina.

窗帘.pinyin: Tā lā shàng le chuāng lián

万一.zh: 万一来不了，我会先给你打电话。
万一.pinyin: Wàn yī lái bù liǎo wǒ huì xiān gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
万一.en: In case I can't come, I'll give you a call beforehand.
万一.es: En caso de que no pueda venir, te marco antes.

万一.zh: 万一有紧急情况，联系我的代理人。
万一.pinyin: Wàn yī yǒu jǐn jí qíng kuàng lián xì wǒ de dài lǐ rén
万一.en: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent.
万一.es: En caso de emergencia, póngase en contacto con mi agente.

万一.pinyin: Wàn yī fā shēng huǒ zāi àn líng
万一.en: In case of fire, ring the bell.
万一.es: En caso de incendio, toca la campana.

万一.zh: 万一发生火灾，打碎玻璃并按下红色按钮。
万一.pinyin: Wàn yī fā shēng huǒ zāi dǎ suì bō li bìng àn xià hóng sè àn niǔ
万一.en: In case of fire, break the glass and push the red button.
万一.es: En caso de incendio, rompa el vidrio y presione el botón rojo.

摇.zh: 我觉得这盏灯短路了，因为只有我摇线的时候灯才会亮。
摇.pinyin: Wǒ jué de zhè zhǎn dēng duǎn lù le yīn wèi zhǐ yǒu wǒ yáo xiàn de shí hou dēng cái huì liàng
摇.en: I think this lamp has a short because the light comes on only if I jiggle the cord.

见解.zh: 至於应该做什么，我和他的见解不同。
见解.pinyin: Zhì yú yīng gāi zuò shén me wǒ hé tā de jiàn jiě bù tóng
见解.en: My view was different from his as to what should be done.

当场.zh: 汤姆被卡车撞到而且当场死亡。
当场.pinyin: Tāng mǔ bèi kǎ chē zhuàng dào ér qiě dāng chǎng sǐ wáng
当场.en: Tom was hit by a truck and died instantly.
当场.es: Tom fue atropellado por un camión y murió al instante.

登陆.zh: 可能我的孙子会是登陆火星的第一人。
登陆.pinyin: Kě néng wǒ de sūn zǐ huì shì dēng lù huǒ xīng de dì yī rén
登陆.en: Maybe my grandchild will be the first person to set foot on Mars.
登陆.es: Puede que mi nieto sea la primera persona que ponga los pies en Marte.

融洽.zh: 我与我的弟弟相处融洽。
融洽.pinyin: Wǒ yǔ wǒ de dì di xiāng chǔ róng qià
融洽.en: I get along with my younger brother.
融洽.es: Me llevo bien con mi hermano menor.

融洽.zh: 他和他所有的同学相处融洽。
融洽.pinyin: Tā hé tā suǒ yǒu de tóng xué xiāng chǔ róng qià
融洽.en: He's getting along well with all of his classmates.
融洽.es: Él se lleva bien con todos sus compañeros de clase.

融洽.zh: 我和婆婆相处得十分融洽。
融洽.pinyin: Wǒ hé pó po xiāng chǔ de shí fēn róng qià
融洽.en: I'm getting along with my mother-in-law very well.
融洽.es: Me llevo muy bien con mi suegra.

融洽.pinyin: Tā men xiāng chǔ róng qià

弹性.zh: 这片人造草皮踩在脚下感觉富有弹性。
弹性.pinyin: Zhè piān rén zào cǎo pí cǎi zài jiǎo xià gǎn jué fù yǒu tán xìng
弹性.en: The astroturf feels springy under your feet.

慷慨.zh: 我很钦佩他的慷慨大方。
慷慨.pinyin: Wǒ hěn qīn pèi tā de kāng kǎi dà fāng
慷慨.en: I had great admiration for his generosity.

慷慨.pinyin: Dà zì rán hěn kāng kǎi

海滨.zh: 他是一家海滨餐厅的服务员。
海滨.pinyin: Tā shì yī jiā hǎi bīn cān tīng de fú wù yuán
海滨.en: He is a waiter in a seaside restaurant.

海滨.zh: 进入这座海滨小镇的车辆大多是前往海边度假营地的。
海滨.pinyin: Jìn rù zhè zuò hǎi bīn xiǎo zhèn de chē liàng dà duō shì qián wǎng hǎi biān dù jià yíng dì de
海滨.en: Most of the traffic coming into this seaside town is heading for the beachside holiday camp.

海滨.zh: 阿尔及尔有一条美丽的海滨长廊。
海滨.pinyin: Ā ěr jí ěr yǒu yī tiáo měi lì de hǎi bīn cháng láng
海滨.en: Algiers has a beautiful promenade on the seashore.

筹备.zh: 她精心筹备了这个派对。
筹备.pinyin: Tā jīng xīn chóu bèi le zhè ge pài duì
筹备.en: She made elaborate preparations for the party.

筹备.pinyin: Tā zhèng zài chóu bèi yī cì lǚ xíng
筹备.en: He is making preparations for a trip.

筹备.zh: 汤姆正在为玛莉筹备生日派对。
筹备.pinyin: Tāng mǔ zhèng zài wèi mǎ lì chóu bèi shēng rì pài duì
筹备.en: Tom is planning a birthday party for Mary.

调节.pinyin: Yīn liàng tiáo jié zài nǎ lǐ

进化.zh: 男人不能变成女人，就像猴子不能进化成人类一样。
进化.pinyin: Nán rén bù néng biàn chéng nǚ rén jiù xiàng hóu zi bù néng jìn huà chéng rén lèi yī yàng
进化.en: A man can no more become a woman than a monkey can develop into a man.

进化.pinyin: Ruǎn jiàn zhèng zài bù duàn jìn huà

颇.zh: 有关癌症成因的研究耗费颇巨。
颇.pinyin: Yǒu guān ái zhèng chéng yīn de yán jiū hào fèi pō jù
颇.en: Research on the causes of cancer is very expensive.
颇.es: La investigación en las causas del cáncer es muy costosa.

颇.zh: 这家报社在当地知名度颇高。
颇.pinyin: Zhè jiā bào shè zài dāng dì zhī míng dù pō gāo
颇.en: This newspaper is well known in the local area.

颇.pinyin: Yì liào zhī wài shōu huò pō fēng

可行.pinyin: Tā de zhǔ yi zǒng shì kě xíng de

撇.zh: 这把剪刀左右撇子都适用。
撇.pinyin: Zhè bǎ jiǎn dāo zuǒ yòu piě zi dōu shì yòng
撇.en: These scissors are suitable for left and right-handed people.
撇.es: Esta tijera vale para zurdos y diestros.

唯独.zh: 快乐存在于过去和未来，唯独不存在于现在。
唯独.pinyin: Kuài lè cún zài yú guò qù hé wèi lái wéi dú bù cún zài yú xiàn zài
唯独.en: Pleasure is always in the past or in the future, never in the present.
唯独.es: Placer siempre se encuentra en pasado o en futuro, pero nunca en presente.

招收.zh: 大学被招收了三个中国学生。
招收.pinyin: Dà xué bèi zhāo shōu le sān gè zhōng guó xué shēng
招收.en: Three Chinese students were admitted to the college.

疏远.zh: 他冷酷的性格使朋友们一个一个地疏远了他。
疏远.pinyin: Tā lěng kù de xìng gé shǐ péng you men yī ge yī ge de shū yuǎn le tā
疏远.en: His coolness has alienated his friends.

肿瘤.zh: 我得了胃肿瘤，必须动手术切除。
肿瘤.pinyin: Wǒ dé le wèi zhǒng liú bì xū dòng shǒu shù qiē chú
肿瘤.en: I got a stomach tumor and had to have it operated on.

补救.zh: 这种问题该有补救办法。
补救.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng wèn tí gāi yǒu bǔ jiù bàn fǎ
补救.en: This type of problem should be able to be solved.

不能.zh: 总有一些东西我永远不能学会，我的生命不是永恒的！
不能.pinyin: Zǒng yǒu yī xiē dōng xi wǒ yǒng yuǎn bù néng xué huì wǒ de shēng mìng bù shì yǒng héng de
不能.en: There will always be things I will never learn, I don't have eternity before me!
不能.es: Siempre habrá cosas que nunca aprenderé, ¡no tengo toda la eternidad ante mí!

不能.pinyin: Wǒ lèi de bù néng zài lèi le
不能.en: I couldn't be any more tired.

不能.pinyin: Wǒ bù néng zhè yàng huó zhe
不能.en: I can't live that kind of life.

不能.zh: 很抱歉，我们不能接受你的要求。
不能.pinyin: Hěn bào qiàn wǒ men bù néng jiē shòu nǐ de yāo qiú
不能.en: I'm very sorry, we can't accept your request.
不能.es: Nosotros lamentamos no poder aceptar su solicitud.

这样.pinyin: Wǒ bù néng zhè yàng huó zhe
这样.en: I can't live that kind of life.

这样.zh: 这样做的话什么都不会改变的。
这样.pinyin: Zhè yàng zuò de huà shén me dōu bù huì gǎi biàn de
这样.es: Eso no va a cambiar nada.

这样.zh: 我没见过也没听过这样的事。
这样.pinyin: Wǒ méi jiàn guo yě méi tīng guo zhè yàng de shì
这样.en: I have neither seen nor heard of such a thing.
这样.es: Nunca he visto o escuchado algo así.

这样.zh: 他跟她说这样的话真是太残忍了。
这样.pinyin: Tā gēn tā shuō zhè yàng de huà zhēn shi tài cán rěn le
这样.en: It is cruel of him to say such things to her.
这样.es: Es cruel de su parte al decirle tales cosas.

我去.pinyin: Wǒ qù bù liǎo yě bù xiǎng qù
我去.en: I cannot go, nor do I want to.
我去.es: No puedo ir, y tampoco quiero.

我去.zh: “你去哪儿了？”“我去了火车站送我的一个朋友。”
我去.pinyin: Nǐ qù nǎr le wǒ qù le huǒ chē zhàn sòng wǒ de yī ge péng you
我去.en: "Where have you been?" "I have been to the station to see a friend off."
我去.es: "¿Dónde has ido?" "He ido a la estación a despedir a un amigo."

我去.pinyin: Diàn huà xiǎng le wǒ qù jiē
Wǒ qù gōng yuán sǎn le bù
我去.en: I went for a walk in the park.
我去.es: Fui al parque a darme un paseo.

不好.zh: 你现在不好好储蓄金钱的话，终有一天会后悔的。
不好.pinyin: Nǐ xiàn zài bù hǎo hǎo chǔ xù jīn qián de huà zhōng yǒu yī tiān huì hòu huǐ de
不好.en: Some day you will come to realize the importance of saving.
不好.es: Algún día te vas a dar cuenta de la importancia de ahorrar.

不好.pinyin: Tā jiǎng bù hǎo fǎ yǔ

不好.en: It is not good to tell a lie.

才能.zh: 我该怎么做才能让你更注意我？
才能.pinyin: Wǒ gāi zěn me zuò cái néng ràng nǐ gèng zhù yì wǒ
才能.en: What have I got to do so that you'll pay attention to me?
才能.es: ¿Qué tengo que hacer para que me prestes atención?

才能.zh: 请告诉我怎样才能联络上他。
才能.pinyin: Qǐng gào su wǒ zěn yàng cái néng lián luò shàng tā
才能.en: Please tell me how I can get in touch with him.
才能.es: Por favor, dime cómo puedo ponerme en contacto con él.

才能.zh: 我想他得花两个小时才能把工作做完。
才能.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng tā de huā liǎng gè xiǎo shí cái néng bǎ gōng zuò zuò wán
才能.en: It will take him two hours to finish the work.
才能.es: Le tomará dos horas terminar el trabajo.

才能.zh: 我们怎样才能停止战争？
才能.pinyin: Wǒ men zěn yàng cái néng tíng zhǐ zhàn zhēng

读书.zh: 你要去伦敦读书是真的吗？
读书.pinyin: Nǐ yào qù lún dūn dú shū shì zhēn de ma
读书.en: Are you really going to London to study?
读书.es: ¿De verdad vas a ir a estudiar a Londres?

读书.zh: 我那个年代的学生大多不读书，但考试却不会不合格。
读书.pinyin: Wǒ nà ge nián dài de xué sheng dà duō bù dú shū dàn kǎo shì què bù huì bù hé gé
读书.en: In our time, there were many students who passed the graduation exam without studying.
读书.es: En nuestros tiempos, había muchos estudiantes que aprobaban el examen de graduación sin estudiar.

读书.zh: 我决定要去外国读书，把父母吓了一跳。
读书.pinyin: Wǒ jué dìng yào qù wài guó dú shū bǎ fù mǔ xià le yī tiào
读书.en: My decision to study abroad surprised my parents.
读书.es: Mi decisión de estudiar en el extranjero sorprendió a mis padres.

读书.zh: 你想去美国读书的话，一定要先申请一张学生签证。
读书.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng qù měi guó dú shū de huà yī dìng yào xiān shēn qǐng yī zhāng xué sheng qiān zhèng
读书.en: If you want to study in the United States, you need to get a student visa.
读书.es: Si quieres estudiar en Estados Unidos, necesitas conseguir una visa de estudiante.

文.zh: 虽然我学了两年中文，但是我还是有很多字不认识。
文.pinyin: Suī rán wǒ xué le liǎng nián zhōng wén dàn shì wǒ hái shi yǒu hěn duō zì bù rèn shi
文.en: Although I have been studying Chinese for 2 years, there are still a lot of words I do not know.
文.es: A pesar de haber estudiado chino durante dos años, todavía hay muchos caracteres que no conozco.

文.zh: 如果我去中国的话，是为了尽可能多地说中文。
文.pinyin: Rú guǒ wǒ qù zhōng guó de huà shì wèi le jǐn kě néng duō de shuō zhòng wén
文.en: If I go to China, it'd be to speak Chinese as much as possible.
文.es: Si fuera a China, sería para hablar chino tanto como sea posible.

文.zh: 你在哪里学义大利文的?
文.pinyin: Nǐ zài nǎ lǐ xué yì dà lì wén de
文.en: Where did you pick up your Italian?

文.zh: 这首诗本来是用法文写的。
文.pinyin: Zhè shǒu shī běn lái shì yòng fǎ wén xiě de
文.en: This poem was originally written in French.
文.es: Este poema fue escrito originalmente en francés.

字典.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de zì diǎn

字典.zh: 我用我的字典查了那几个字。
字典.pinyin: Wǒ yòng wǒ de zì diǎn chá le nà jǐ ge zì
字典.en: I looked up the words in my dictionary.
字典.es: Yo busqué las palabras en mi diccionario.

字典.zh: 我能用一下你的字典吗？
字典.pinyin: Wǒ néng yòng yī xià nǐ de zì diǎn ma
字典.en: Can I use your dictionary for a minute?

字典.zh: 我的字典里没有这个词。
字典.pinyin: Wǒ de zì diǎn lǐ méi yǒu zhè ge cí
字典.en: The word is not in my dictionary.
字典.es: La palabra no aparece en mi diccionario.

大声.pinyin: Tā shuō de hěn dà shēng
Bù yào dà shēng shuō huà

大声.zh: 把收音机调大声点。我听不清楚。
大声.pinyin: Bǎ shōu yīn jī diào dà shēng diǎn wǒ tīng bù qīng chu
大声.en: Turn up the radio. I can't hear it.
大声.es: Sube el volumen del radio, no lo oigo bien.

关上.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ liù shān chuāng dōu guān shàng le

关上.zh: 为了不吵醒宝宝，我静静地关上了门。
关上.pinyin: Wèi le bù chǎo xǐng bǎo bao wǒ jìng jìng de guān shàng le mén
关上.en: I shut the door quietly so as not to wake the baby.
关上.es: Cerré suavemente la puerta para no despertar al bebé.

关上.zh: 好像快要下雨了。我们把窗关上吧。
关上.pinyin: Hǎo xiàng kuài yào xià yǔ le wǒ men bǎ chuāng guān shàng ba
关上.en: It looks like rain. We had better shut the windows.
关上.es: Parece que va a llover. Deberíamos cerrar las ventanas.

关上.zh: 她把房间里的窗子全都关上了。
关上.pinyin: Tā bǎ fáng jiān lǐ de chuāng zi quán dōu guān shàng le
关上.en: She closed all the windows in the room.
关上.es: Ella cerró todas las ventanas en la habitación.

写字.zh: 给我一些我可以在上面写字的东西。
写字.pinyin: Gěi wǒ yī xiē wǒ kě yǐ zài shàng miàn xiě zì de dōng xi
写字.en: Give me something to write on.

写字.zh: 我需要一些用来写字的东西。
写字.pinyin: Wǒ xū yào yī xiē yòng lái xiě zì de dōng xi
写字.en: I need something to write with.

写字.zh: 给我些可以写字的东西。
写字.pinyin: Gěi wǒ xiē kě yǐ xiě zì de dōng xi
写字.en: Give me something to write with.

写字.zh: 请不要在图书馆的书籍上写字。
写字.pinyin: Qǐng bù yào zài tú shū guǎn de shū jí shàng xiě zì
写字.en: Please do not write in this library book.
写字.es: Por favor, no escriba en este libro de la biblioteca.

好久.zh: 我们终於见面了！我等这一刻等了好久了。
好久.pinyin: Wǒ men zhōng yú jiàn miàn le wǒ děng zhè yī kè děng le hǎo jiǔ le
好久.en: So, we finally meet! I've waited so long for this moment.
好久.es: ¡Entonces finalmente nos conocemos! Esperé mucho por este momento.

好久.zh: 我已经好久没有见到你了。
好久.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ jīng hǎo jiǔ méi yǒu jiàn dào nǐ le
好久.en: I haven't seen you in ages.
好久.es: Tiene muchísimo tiempo que no te veo.

好久.zh: 我们等了好久，但是她还是没有出现。
好久.pinyin: Wǒ men děng le hǎo jiǔ dàn shì tā hái shi méi yǒu chū xiàn
好久.en: We waited a long time, but she didn't show up.
好久.es: Esperamos largo rato, pero no apareció.

好久.zh: 我已经好久没有去锻炼了。
好久.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ jīng hǎo jiǔ méi yǒu qù duàn liàn le
好久.en: I haven't exercised in a long time.
好久.es: No he hecho ejercicio en tanto tiempo.

装满.pinyin: Wǒ zài tǒng zi lǐ zhuāng mǎn le shuǐ
装满.en: I filled the bucket with water.
装满.es: Yo llené el balde con agua.

装满.zh: 他有个装满草莓的篮子。
装满.pinyin: Tā yǒu gè zhuāng mǎn cǎo méi de lán zi
装满.en: He has a basket full of strawberries.
装满.es: Tiene una cesta llena de fresas.

装满.zh: 这里有个装满蔬菜的篮子。
装满.pinyin: Zhè lǐ yǒu gè zhuāng mǎn shū cài de lán zi
装满.en: Here is a basket full of vegetables.
装满.es: Aquí hay una canasta llena de verduras.

装满.pinyin: Tā yòng shuǐ zhuāng mǎn le píng zi
装满.en: He filled the bottle with water.

说实话.pinyin: Shuō shí huà wǒ bìng bù xǐ huan nǐ
说实话.en: To be honest, I don't like you at all.
说实话.es: Para ser honestos, no me gustas para nada.

说实话.pinyin: Wǒ zǒng shì shì zhe shuō shí huà
说实话.en: I always try to tell the truth.
说实话.es: Siempre trato de decir la verdad.

说实话.pinyin: Tā zǒng shì shuō shí huà
Shuō shí huà wǒ gǎn dào gū dú
说实话.en: To tell the truth, I felt lonely.
说实话.es: A decir verdad, me sentía solo.

不在乎.zh: 我不在乎别人怎么看我的打扮。
不在乎.pinyin: Wǒ bù zài hu bié ren zěn me kàn wǒ de dǎ ban
不在乎.en: I don't care what people think about the way I dress.
不在乎.es: No me importa lo que la gente piense de cómo me visto.

不在乎.pinyin: Wǒ bù zài hu tā zuò shén me
不在乎.en: I don't care what he does.
不在乎.es: No me interesa lo que él haga.

不在乎.pinyin: Wǒ bù zài hu tā men shuō shén me
不在乎.en: I don't care what they say.
不在乎.es: No me importa lo que digan.

不在乎.pinyin: Wǒ men bù zài hu tā zuò shén me
不在乎.en: We don't care what he does.
不在乎.es: No nos importa lo que él haga.

备.zh: 我正忙著为明天作准备。
备.pinyin: Wǒ zhèng máng zhe wèi míng tiān zuò zhǔn bèi
备.en: I'm busy getting ready for tomorrow.

备.pinyin: Nǐ yī zhǔn bèi hǎo wǒ men jiù zǒu
备.en: We'll leave as soon as you're ready.

备.pinyin: Nǐ bù zhǔn bèi qù shì ma
备.en: You don't intend going there, do you?

备.zh: 我今晚不准备出去玩，我要预备功课。
备.pinyin: Wǒ jīn wǎn bù zhǔn bèi chū qù wán wǒ yào yù bèi gōng kè
备.en: I don't plan to hang out tonight. I need to prepare for my lessons.

扇.pinyin: Tā zá huài de shì zhè shān chuāng
